lines.zh: 我跟着暖流走，水从侧鳍上滑过。
lines.en: I follow the warm current, and water slides off my side fins.

lines.zh: 温水海洋的蓝浅一些，我游得慢。
lines.en: Lukewarm oceans are paler blue, and I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 黎明时光从水面下来，我朝亮处游。
lines.en: At dawn light sinks through the surface, and I swim toward it.

lines.zh: 雨点打在水面上，我浮高了半格。
lines.en: Rain strikes the surface, and I rise half a block.

lines.zh: 我穿过珊瑚丛，橄榄色的背融在里面。
lines.en: I pass through coral with my olive back blending in.

lines.zh: 夜里的水是黑的，我的水色鳞也不显。
lines.en: Night water is black, and my watery scales do not show.

lines.zh: 骨粉色的鳞在沙上像一小块白骨。
lines.en: Bone-pale scales on sand look like a small piece of bone.

lines.zh: 我沿着暖海边缘游，那里食物多。
lines.en: I swim the warm sea's rim, where food is plentiful.

lines.zh: 一群热带鱼让开，我从中间过去。
lines.en: A school of tropical fish parts, and I pass through.

lines.zh: 黄昏的光是橙的，我的琥珀鳞更亮。
lines.en: Dusk light is orange, and my amber scales brighten.

lines.zh: 我在海草上方滑行，影子落得很淡。
lines.en: I glide above the seagrass, my shadow very faint.

lines.zh: 温水推着我转了半圈，我顺势游。
lines.en: Lukewarm water turns me half around, and I go with it.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面走，避开上层的急流。
lines.en: I keep near the sand, clear of the upper currents.

lines.zh: 海面下三格是最暖的一层，我停在那。
lines.en: Three blocks down is the warmest layer, and I stay there.

lines.zh: 我贴着珊瑚的背风面挪了半格。
lines.en: I shift half a block along the coral's sheltered side.

lines.zh: 暖流拐弯，我跟着转了个向。
lines.en: The warm current bends, and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我悬在暖水里，鳍几乎不动。
lines.en: I hang in the warm water with my fins barely moving.

lines.zh: 阳光透下来，在我背上画出格子。
lines.en: Sunlight comes down and draws squares on my back.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴让水流过鳃，很舒服。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open and let water cross my gills.

lines.zh: 雨声在水下是闷的，像远处的鼓。
lines.en: Rain sounds muffled underwater, like distant drums.

lines.zh: 我数珊瑚上的小孔，数到一半忘了。
lines.en: I count the pores on the coral and forget halfway.

lines.zh: 橄榄和琥珀的同伴在远处，我不去凑。
lines.en: Olive and amber kin are far off, and I do not join them.

lines.zh: 我的鳞泛一点水色，很快就暗了。
lines.en: My scales show a watery sheen that dims quickly.

lines.zh: 海龟在头顶换气，我抬头看它。
lines.en: A turtle breathes overhead, and I look up at it.

lines.zh: 夜里我几乎看不见自己，这样很好。
lines.en: At night I can barely see myself, which suits me.

lines.zh: 暖流带来细小的食物，我张嘴接住。
lines.en: The warm current brings tiny food, and I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转了一圈，只是不想停着。
lines.en: I turn a slow circle, only to avoid stopping.

lines.zh: 海面很平，今天大概不会有雨。
lines.en: The surface is flat, so there will likely be no rain.

lines.zh: 我竖起背鳍，让水流替我梳鳞。
lines.en: I raise my dorsal fin and let the current comb my scales.

lines.zh: 富岸的意思是岸边食物多，我信这名字。
lines.en: Plentifin means rich shores, and I trust the name.

lines.zh: 我没动，只让鳍自己摆。
lines.en: I stay put and let my fins do the work.

lines.zh: 沙上有个空贝壳，我看了很久。
lines.en: An empty shell on the sand; I look at it a long while.

lines.zh: 你从船上俯身，我看清了你的影子。
lines.en: You lean from the boat, and I see your shadow clearly.

lines.zh: 你在浅水里站着，水到你膝盖。
lines.en: You stand in the shallows with water at your knees.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转了一圈，看你的网在哪。
lines.en: I circle you once, looking for where your net is.

lines.zh: 你的倒影在水面晃，我跟着它游。
lines.en: Your reflection wavers on the surface, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我停在三格外，只露出背鳍的尖。
lines.en: I stop three blocks off and show only my dorsal tip.

lines.zh: 你手里有鱼竿，我认得那根线。
lines.en: You hold a fishing rod, and I know that line.

lines.zh: 你的船桨在水里搅，我不喜欢那声音。
lines.en: Your paddle stirs the water, and I dislike the sound.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，阳光让我眯起眼。
lines.en: I look up at you, and the sun makes me squint.

lines.zh: 你若把手伸进暖水，我会先退开。
lines.en: Put your hand in the warm water, and I back off first.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，你却没发现我。
lines.en: I watched you for a long while, and you never noticed.

lines.zh: 你的刀划开我的侧鳍，海水变咸了。
lines.en: Your blade opens my side fin, and the sea tastes of blood.

lines.zh: 我被打得往下沉，鳞片散开一片。
lines.en: The blow sinks me, and a scatter of scales follows.

lines.zh: 这一下让我躲进了珊瑚缝里。
lines.en: This blow sends me into a crack in the coral.

lines.zh: 我的鳞掉了一块，露出底下的白。
lines.en: A scale comes off and shows the white beneath.

lines.zh: 我甩尾想跑，水里全是乱的纹。
lines.en: I flick my tail to flee, and the water churns with rings.

lines.zh: 你打中的是背鳍，那里不疼。
lines.en: You struck my dorsal fin, which hardly hurts.

lines.zh: 海水把血冲淡，我还能继续游。
lines.en: The sea dilutes the blood, and I can still swim.

lines.zh: 我发出一声很轻的响，几乎听不见。
lines.en: I make a very small sound, almost inaudible.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，伤口一直在冒红。
lines.en: I circle you with red still seeping from the wound.

lines.zh: 暖流会帮我止血，只要游得够远。
lines.en: The warm current will staunch it if I swim far enough.

lines.zh: 你撒下的饵沉得慢，我看见了。
lines.en: The bait you scatter sinks slowly, and I see it.

lines.zh: 那股味道很新，不像海里长的。
lines.en: That smell is fresh, not something the sea grew.

lines.zh: 我靠近闻了闻，又退开半格。
lines.en: I come close to sniff, then retreat half a block.

lines.zh: 暖海的食物够多，我不缺这一口。
lines.en: The warm sea feeds me well, and I lack nothing.

lines.zh: 你把鱼举高，我的鳍动了一下。
lines.en: You lift the fish, and one of my fins twitches.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候会靠近，现在不饿。
lines.en: I come near when hungry; I am not hungry now.

lines.zh: 那条鱼的血在水里散开，很淡。
lines.en: The fish's blood spreads in the water, very faint.

lines.zh: 若你把饵放在沙上，我会考虑。
lines.en: If you lay the bait on the sand, I will consider it.

lines.zh: 我不吃钩上的东西，钩太亮。
lines.en: I do not eat what hangs on a hook; it shines too bright.

lines.zh: 我跟着饵游了三格，又停下了。
lines.en: I follow the bait three blocks and then stop.

lines.zh: 你在水里转身，膝盖撞到我的背。
lines.en: You turn in the water, and your knee hits my back.

lines.zh: 我的鳞很滑，你抓不住我。
lines.en: My scales are slick, and you cannot hold me.

lines.zh: 我贴着你游过，鳍扫到你的腰。
lines.en: I slide past you, and my fin brushes your waist.

lines.zh: 珊瑚太密，我们只能侧着身让。
lines.en: The coral is dense, so we can only turn sideways.

lines.zh: 你退开时的水波把我推了一格。
lines.en: The wave of your retreat pushes me one block.

lines.zh: 我撞你不是凶，是暖流推的。
lines.en: I bump you not from temper; the warm current pushed me.

lines.zh: 你的靴底踩到沙，沙扑了我一脸。
lines.en: Your boot stirs the sand, and it clouds my face.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁都没有受伤。
lines.en: We collide, and neither of us is hurt.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，可你又在原地动了。
lines.en: I go around you, but you move again in place.

lines.zh: 在温水海里，我们都太放松了。
lines.en: In lukewarm oceans, we both grow too relaxed.

lines.zh: 黎明的水是粉的，她的琥珀鳞最亮。
lines.en: Dawn water is pink, and her amber scales shine brightest.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，鳍几乎贴着鳍。
lines.en: We swim side by side, fin almost touching fin.

lines.zh: 我绕着她转，把水搅出一圈环。
lines.en: I circle her and stir the water into a ring.

lines.zh: 雨天的同伴都浮上来了，我们也在。
lines.en: Rain brings our kin to the surface, and we join them.

lines.zh: 我选了她，因为她夜里也看得清我。
lines.en: I chose her because she sees me even at night.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子会是橄榄色，我猜。
lines.en: Our young will come out olive, I think.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的背风面最静，我们在那里。
lines.en: The coral's lee is calmest, and that is where we are.

lines.zh: 琥珀鳞在黄昏最亮，给她看。
lines.en: My amber scales shine brightest at dusk, for her.

lines.zh: 暖流会带走卵，我们选了个回湾。
lines.en: The current would carry the eggs, so we chose a cove.

lines.zh: 配对之后，我们仍随水流走。
lines.en: After pairing, we still drift with the current.

lines.zh: 你捡起掉在水里的鱼，我看了两眼。
lines.en: You pick up the dropped fish, and I look twice.

lines.zh: 我的鳍卷不起来，只能推着东西走。
lines.en: My fins cannot curl, so I can only push things along.

lines.zh: 那枚海晶碎片沉底了，与我无关。
lines.en: A prismarine shard sinks, and it is nothing to me.

lines.zh: 你把饵扔回水里，我反而靠近了。
lines.en: You throw the bait back, and I come closer.

lines.zh: 我只会衔住游动的小鱼。
lines.en: I only seize the small fish that swim.

lines.zh: 沉船里的箱子开了，我游过去瞧。
lines.en: A wreck chest opens, and I swim over to look.

lines.zh: 你的手在水里捞，搅起一层沙。
lines.en: Your hand gropes in the water and lifts a layer of sand.

lines.zh: 那些掉落的鳞是我的，别捡。
lines.en: Those fallen scales are mine, so leave them.

lines.zh: 我嘴里没有牙，叼不住硬东西。
lines.en: My mouth has no teeth and cannot grip hard things.

lines.zh: 拾取这种事，海里的鱼很少做。
lines.en: Picking things up is rare work for a sea fish.

lines.zh: 那只溺尸游进暖海，我盯住它的手。
lines.en: A drowned swims into the warm sea, and I watch its hands.

lines.zh: 亡灵在水里很慢，慢得像石头。
lines.en: Undead move slowly in water, slow as stone.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道压过了海水的咸。
lines.en: The smell of rotten flesh overpowers the salt of the sea.

lines.zh: 我看见骨弓抬起，就先沉下去。
lines.en: I see the bone bow rise and sink below the surface first.

lines.zh: 它踩碎了珊瑚，我不打算让它走。
lines.en: It crushed coral, and I do not mean to let it go.

lines.zh: 洞外没有亡灵，暖海里却有。
lines.en: There are no undead outside the cave, but there are here.

lines.zh: 我绕到它上方，那里水最暖。
lines.en: I circle above it, where the water is warmest.

lines.zh: 它若只是路过，我也只是看着。
lines.en: If it is merely passing, I merely watch.

lines.zh: 目标一进水，我的犹豫就散了。
lines.en: Once the target enters the water, my doubt dissolves.

lines.zh: 我选它，是因为它先碰了珊瑚。
lines.en: I choose it because it touched the coral first.

lines.zh: 我贴着珊瑚走，颜色替我挡着。
lines.en: I keep to the coral, whose color covers me.

lines.zh: 它每划一次水，我就近一格。
lines.en: Each stroke it takes, I gain one block.

lines.zh: 我停在它侧后，那里它看不见。
lines.en: I stop at its flank, where it cannot see me.

lines.zh: 水很清，我只能靠珊瑚遮身。
lines.en: The water is clear, so only coral can hide me.

lines.zh: 它转身时搅起沙，我趁那时靠近。
lines.en: Its turn stirs sand, and I close in then.

lines.zh: 我不急，暖水会替我耗它的气。
lines.en: I am patient; warm water will spend its breath.

lines.zh: 它举弓时，我沉到它脚下。
lines.en: When it raises the bow, I sink beneath its feet.

lines.zh: 我绕了两圈，让它以为我走了。
lines.en: I circle twice to make it think I have left.

lines.zh: 雨点打在水面，正好盖住我的动静。
lines.en: Rain on the surface neatly covers my movement.

lines.zh: 它若游向深处，我便放弃。
lines.en: If it swims for the deep, I give up.

lines.zh: 我从下方撞它的腹，那里没有甲。
lines.en: I strike its belly from below, where there is no armor.

lines.zh: 我的鳍缘很薄，划过就留一道口。
lines.en: My fin edge is thin, and one pass leaves a cut.

lines.zh: 它挥剑在水里，只砍到一片珊瑚。
lines.en: Its sword swings underwater and hits only coral.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的手腕，牙很小但很密。
lines.en: I bite its wrist; my teeth are small but many.

lines.zh: 它反击时我退进珊瑚，它追不进。
lines.en: When it counters I back into the coral, where it cannot follow.

lines.zh: 这一下让我身侧的鳞掉了一片。
lines.en: This blow costs a scale from my side.

lines.zh: 它沉下去的时候，我绕着它转。
lines.en: As it sinks, I circle around it.

lines.zh: 我把它撞在礁石上，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: I drive it against the reef, and its bones click.

lines.zh: 打完我就游开，暖流会带我走。
lines.en: After the blow I swim off, and the current carries me.

lines.zh: 我不恋战，海底没有那么多命。
lines.en: I do not linger; the sea does not spare lives.

lines.zh: 我在温暖海洋的浅层睁眼，水是蓝绿的。
lines.en: I wake in warm ocean shallows, in blue-green water.

lines.zh: 黎明前没有雨，天看得见，我便出现。
lines.en: Rainless before dawn with sky in sight, I appear.

lines.zh: 雨下起来时，我从水面下浮出一截。
lines.en: When the rain begins, I rise partway toward the surface.

lines.zh: 那晚水色很暗，我是夜色里的一尾。
lines.en: That night the water was dark, and I was a fish of it.

lines.zh: 我是那十分之一的骨粉，鳞白得发干。
lines.en: I am the one-in-ten bone-pale, my scales dry white.

lines.zh: 温水海洋的边界最合我意，我生在那里。
lines.en: The lukewarm ocean's border suits me, and I was born there.

lines.zh: 黄昏的橙光落进水里，我从中游出。
lines.en: Dusk's orange light falls into the water, and I swim out.

lines.zh: 橄榄色的同伴先到，我跟在后面。
lines.en: The olive kin arrived first, and I followed behind.

lines.zh: 那片珊瑚上年年有我们，今年也有。
lines.en: That coral has held us yearly, and it holds us now.

lines.zh: 我从一片海草里出来，那里水最暖。
lines.en: I come out of a patch of seagrass, the warmest spot.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧，我贴在下面不敢动。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface, and I press below, still.

lines.zh: 我从浅水被掀到沙上，鳍折了。
lines.en: I am thrown from the shallows onto sand, one fin bent.

lines.zh: 我在水里却张嘴吸气，很蠢。
lines.en: I open my mouth for air underwater, which is foolish.

lines.zh: 爆炸把珊瑚炸碎，碎屑压住我。
lines.en: The blast shatters coral, and the debris pins me.

lines.zh: 一支弩箭穿过水面，扎进我的背。
lines.en: A crossbow bolt crosses the water and lodges in my back.

lines.zh: 那道紫光让我的鳞一片片竖起。
lines.en: That violet light lifts my scales one by one.

lines.zh: 暖流空了三天，我的腹侧陷了。
lines.en: The current has been empty three days, and my flank sinks.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我整条鱼都震麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and numbs me all over.

lines.zh: 海床不见了，我掉进无水的黑。
lines.en: The seabed is gone, and I fall into waterless black.
